{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
# 1. conversion rate = proportion of converted=1
# 2. customer segments: new, returning, loyal
print("Unique customer segments:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# 3. No other filters — use all orders
# Compute conversion rate for each segment over all orders
conversion_rates = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Display conversion rates
conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
